title: Battle of Rapallo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Rapallo", at revision 1370587157, opens: "The Battle of Rapallo, was fought between Swiss mercenaries on French pay and their Genoese-Milanese allies led by Louis d'Orleans against Neapolitan forces led by Giulio Orsini on 5 September 1494 near Rapallo." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16950664, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1494 first battle of the Italian Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
